no_adcom_quote.quote: No advisory committee meeting was held, and no external consultations were requested for this NDA.

summary: IOMERVU (iomeprol, NDA216017, co-filed with NDA216016 and reviewed in a single Multidisciplinary review) had no advisory committee meeting. Section 9 of the Multidisciplinary review states plainly that no advisory committee meeting was held and no external consultations were requested. With no AdComm convened, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
